_doc: v0.88.6 — Source of truth for SynaptoDeck's feature inventory.
Maintained by hand. Whenever a feature ships, REMOVES, or changes status,
this file is updated IN THE SAME COMMIT as the code change.
The marketing site (synaptodeck.app, separate repo) receives this file
via a CI-driven sync workflow on every change, so updating the manifest
is equivalent to updating the site.
No second source of truth. No marketing-site PR per feature.
1. Pick a stable kebab-case id (used as a URL fragment + slot key)
2. Choose a category from the categories[] list below
3. status: 'live' for shipped, 'beta' for behind a flag, 'planned' for backlog
4. versionIntroduced: the tag where it shipped (e.g. 'v0.84.0')
6. marketingCopy: 1-2 sentence user-facing (what it gives them)
7. icon: lucide-react icon name (the marketing site uses lucide)
8. screenshot: optional /screenshots/<id>.png — site renders if file exists
When REMOVING a feature: just delete the entry. The site rebuilds without it.
When DEPRECATING: change status to 'deprecated' (kept visible with a note).
Schema: see features.schema.json for the full type.

features.name: Programmable grid
features.description: Configurable rows × columns of buttons. 1×1 to 8×8 (or larger).
features.marketingCopy: Lay out exactly the deck you need. Resize the grid anytime — your buttons reflow.

features.name: Multiple pages per profile
features.description: Each profile contains paginated pages; favourites + hotkeys per page.
features.marketingCopy: Group your buttons however you think — work, personal, games, side projects. One swipe between them.

features.name: Multiple profiles
features.description: Separate deck configurations; switch instantly from the sidebar.
features.marketingCopy: One deck for streaming, one for dev, one for the kitchen. Switch with a click.

features.name: Per-profile wallpaper
features.description: Custom background image per profile.
features.marketingCopy: Make each deck feel like its own space.

features.name: Per-profile accent colour
features.description: accentColor field on AppDeckProfile; CSS variable override at deck wrapper.
features.marketingCopy: Tint each profile with its own colour — blue for work, pink for streaming, green for dev. Glow, focus rings, hover states all match. Switch profiles, the whole deck repaints instantly.

features.name: Global hotkeys
features.description: OS-level keyboard shortcut per button — fires from any app.
features.marketingCopy: Trigger any button from anywhere, even when SynaptoDeck isn't focused.

features.name: Themes (light/dark/cyberpunk/tactile)
features.description: 4 built-in themes + per-button styles + tactile press animations.
features.marketingCopy: Make it look how you want — clean, glassy, neon, or like a real button deck.

features.name: Launchers (URL / app / file / folder)
features.description: open_url, open_app, open_file, open_folder action types.
features.marketingCopy: One click → opens a URL, app, file, or folder. The bread and butter.

features.name: Copy text to clipboard
features.description: copy_text action — stash repeated snippets behind a button.
features.marketingCopy: Email signatures, code snippets, your zoom link — one tap to the clipboard.

features.name: Send keystrokes
features.description: keystroke action with both literal-text and DSL-sequence modes (modifiers + named keys).
features.marketingCopy: Fire a shortcut into the foreground app — perfect for tools that don't have global hotkey APIs.

features.name: Run shell commands
features.description: shell_command action with shell autodetect, cwd override, output capture (toast/clipboard).
features.marketingCopy: Run any script as a button. See its output in a toast or grab it from the clipboard.

features.name: HTTP request action
features.description: http_request action with full method/header/body support, JSONPath response extraction, secret substitution.
features.marketingCopy: Hit any API as a button. Inject secrets safely from your OS keychain.

features.name: Wake on LAN
features.description: wake_on_lan action — broadcasts a magic packet to a MAC address on the LAN.
features.marketingCopy: Wake your desktop, NAS, or media server from your phone. No router config required.

features.name: System volume control
features.description: volume_up, volume_down, volume_mute via OS audio APIs.
features.marketingCopy: Volume up, down, mute — one button each. Works system-wide.

features.name: Media transport keys
features.description: media_play_pause, media_next, media_previous routed through OS media keys.
features.marketingCopy: Play / pause / skip the current track — works for Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube in any browser.

features.name: Workflow chains
features.description: workflow action — sequence of sub-actions with optional delays + stop-on-error.
features.marketingCopy: Chain multiple actions behind one button. "Start my workday" = open Slack + Notion + a playlist + a terminal, all from one tap.

features.name: Clock widget
features.description: Live clock + date, updates every second.
features.marketingCopy: Always know what time it is without leaving the deck.

features.name: Weather widget
features.description: Current temperature + conditions for your configured location.
features.marketingCopy: Skip the weather app — your deck shows it.

features.name: Calendar peek widget
features.description: Next N events from any iCal URL (Google / iCloud / Outlook).
features.marketingCopy: Your next meeting, always visible. No app-switching to check the schedule.

features.name: Stock price widget
features.description: Live stock / crypto price ticker.
features.marketingCopy: Watch a ticker without the brokerage app open.

features.name: CI status widget
features.description: Build status for your GitHub Actions / GitLab CI pipeline.
features.marketingCopy: Green build? Red build? Glance at your deck instead of opening the dashboard.

features.name: Sentry error count widget
features.description: Live unresolved-issue count from any Sentry project.
features.marketingCopy: See your error count without leaving what you're doing.

features.name: Audit log widget
features.description: Recent audit events from your deck — what fired, when.
features.marketingCopy: Your deck's recent activity at a glance — useful for debugging webhooks + triggers.

features.name: Custom HTTP widget
features.description: http_custom widget — fetches any URL, extracts a value via dot-path, displays it.
features.marketingCopy: Wire any API to a button without writing code. JSON in, value out.

features.name: Spotify Now Playing strip
features.description: Album art + track + artist + transport controls in a horizontal strip widget.
features.marketingCopy: See what's playing without opening Spotify.

features.name: AI Builder via MCP
features.description: Sidecar exposes MCP tools to Claude Desktop / Cursor / Cline / Claude Code. AI proposes buttons + pages.
features.marketingCopy: Connect Claude (or any MCP client) and ask it to build buttons for you. Every proposal lands in an inbox — you approve, SynaptoDeck applies. AI never writes to your deck directly.

features.name: AI Builder direct (Claude/OpenAI/Ollama)
features.description: Generate buttons + pages from a prompt using Anthropic / OpenAI / local Ollama providers.
features.marketingCopy: Describe the deck you want in plain English. Pick from 3-8 suggestions; approve to apply.

features.name: Paste-JSON import
features.description: Paste structured JSON from any AI chat → lands in the Suggestion Inbox.
features.marketingCopy: Don't want to wire up an API key? Paste JSON from ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini and we'll validate it.

features.name: AI Suggestion Inbox
features.description: Every AI proposal queues here with risk classification; user approves/rejects.
features.marketingCopy: AI suggests. SynaptoDeck validates. You approve. SynaptoDeck applies. Every change is reviewable, every action auditable.

features.name: Mobile Remote (PWA)
features.description: Browser-based PWA paired via QR code over LAN; pinch-zoom, tap to fire buttons.
features.marketingCopy: Turn your phone into a SynaptoDeck remote in 10 seconds. No App Store install, no cloud account. Pair by QR, control your desktop from anywhere on your network.

features.name: Mobile profile switching
features.description: Phone PWA can switch the active profile on the desktop.
features.marketingCopy: Flip your desktop deck to a different profile from your phone. Useful when you're in another room.

features.name: Spotify deep integration
features.description: OAuth PKCE auth, 9 control actions, search modal, Now Playing strip widget, volume slider.
features.marketingCopy: Full Spotify control without Alt-Tab. Play, pause, skip, search, change volume, see what's playing — all on the deck.

features.name: Inbound notifications / webhooks
features.description: POST /api/notify endpoint with toast/banner/blocking-modal variants.
features.marketingCopy: Wire any system (CI, monitoring, smart home) to push notifications into SynaptoDeck. Visible without leaving your deck.

features.name: Webhook triggers
features.description: POST /api/trigger endpoint to fire any button remotely (hidden behind feature flag in v0.81.1).
features.marketingCopy: Let your smart-home doorbell, your CI build, or your Slack bot fire a SynaptoDeck button. Coming out of beta soon.

features.name: All-apps import recipe
features.description: One-click scan of Start Menu (Win) / /Applications (mac) → page of one-button-per-installed-app.
features.marketingCopy: Make a deck of every app on your machine in one click. Real icons, alphabetical, auto-sized.

features.name: Recipes (button + page templates)
features.description: Curated pre-built button + page templates across productivity, dev, IDE, media, streamer categories.
features.marketingCopy: Don't start from a blank deck. Pick a recipe — Daily Apps, IDE Launchers, Spotify Deck — and tweak from there.

features.name: Audit log
features.description: Every action fire is logged with timestamp, source, status; CSV export.
features.marketingCopy: Every action your deck has fired, ever. Filter, search, export to CSV. Indispensable when something misbehaves.

features.name: Secrets in OS keychain
features.description: ${SECRET:name} substitution at fire time; stored in Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain.
features.marketingCopy: API keys never sit in plaintext. SynaptoDeck stores them in your OS keychain and substitutes them at fire time. AI never sees the values.

features.name: Optional crash reporting
features.description: Sentry integration, off by default, user consent required, full PII scrubbing.
features.marketingCopy: Help us fix bugs you don't even notice — or don't. Crash reporting is off by default and asks before sending anything.

features.name: In-app feedback channel
features.description: Report a Problem + Ask SynaptoDeck to Learn This — posts to GitHub issues via Cloudflare Worker.
features.marketingCopy: Stuck? Wish something existed? Tell us from inside the app — your message becomes a GitHub issue, with the right context attached.

features.name: New Capability Learned banner
features.description: When a feature you requested ships, SynaptoDeck shows a personalised banner on first launch.
features.marketingCopy: Asked for a feature six weeks ago and forgot? When it ships, your SynaptoDeck remembers and tells you.

features.name: Signed auto-updater
features.description: Tauri minisign-signed deltas pulled from GitHub releases; update in place.
features.marketingCopy: Stay current automatically. Cryptographically signed updates — no third party can hand your machine a fake SynaptoDeck.

features.name: Cross-platform (Windows + macOS)
features.description: Tauri 2 binaries for win64 + macOS Apple Silicon.
features.marketingCopy: Same SynaptoDeck on your Windows desktop and your MacBook. Your config sync is in your hands.

features.name: Local-first, no cloud required
features.description: All config + secrets + audit log lives on the user's machine.
features.marketingCopy: No account. No server. Your deck lives on your machine — works offline, gone if you uninstall.

features.name: Free forever (personal use)
features.description: All features above ship in the free tier. Pro tier (planned) adds cloud sync, multi-device, AI quota, premium recipes.
features.marketingCopy: Every feature you see here is free for personal use. The upcoming Pro tier adds cloud sync across devices + premium integrations.

features.name: Pro tier — cloud sync + multi-device
features.description: Multi-tenant Workspaces, cloud backup of deck config, multi-device sync, premium recipes (Tapo / Hue / Sonos / Home Assistant), unlimited AI quota.
features.marketingCopy: Coming soon: sync your decks across devices, premium smart-home recipes, and unlimited AI Builder usage. Pricing TBD; free tier stays free.

features.name: AI Routines v1
features.description: Chain AI-orchestrated actions: "summarise the last 20 unread emails into a Notion page and put a button on my deck for the highest-priority one."
features.marketingCopy: Coming soon: AI Routines turn your deck into an agent. Set a goal, AI runs the steps, you keep the button as a one-tap repeat.

features.name: Cmd+K global search
features.description: Cmd+K opens a global typeahead over every button across every page across every profile. Ranks by title-exact > title-prefix > title-substring > page name > profile name > action target. Enter fires the result via the existing runButton dispatch.
features.marketingCopy: Press Cmd+K from anywhere. Type to find any button you've ever made — across every deck. Enter to fire it. The Raycast / Alfred experience, applied to your deck.

features.name: Stacks / Smart Folders
features.description: Drag a button onto another → creates a stack; tap to expand into a popover grid; collapses on outside-click.
features.marketingCopy: Coming soon: Stacks let you group related buttons under one slot. Tap to fan them out, tap outside to collapse.

features.name: Side dashboard pane
features.description: Always-visible side column with weather, time, date, notes, battery, system info.
features.marketingCopy: Coming soon: a dedicated side panel for ambient info — time, weather, notes — so your deck stays focused on actions.

features.name: Hidden pages + biometric unlock
features.description: Pages locked behind Windows Hello / Touch ID / passcode.
features.marketingCopy: Future: hide sensitive deck pages behind your fingerprint or Windows Hello. Sensitive shell commands stay protected.

features.name: Premium smart-home recipes
features.description: Tapo, Philips Hue, Sonos, Home Assistant, Notion, Linear — one-click recipes.
features.marketingCopy: Coming soon: one-click recipes for Hue lights, Sonos speakers, Home Assistant, Tapo plugs, Notion + Linear. All as a single Pro tier add-on.
